scope: development PC; PostgreSQL 16; disposable database; one random inv_app login; single holder and single waiter

session.connectionModel: new psycopg connection per Database.transaction; no pool
session.runtimeRoleClass: random inv_app_* NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS login inheriting inv_kernel

projectRowLock.waiter: runtime SELECT project_id ... FOR NO KEY UPDATE

conclusion: With the configured session, a heavyweight project-row lock wait is cut by lock_timeout as 55P03 before statement_timeout. The historical 57014 cannot be attributed to that lock wait from the statement label alone; its original wait_event was not captured.
